title: Puka Nacua reveals secret Matthew Stafford told him before MVP speech

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Puka Nacua reveals secret Matthew Stafford told him before MVP speech
sources.description: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua reveals on ESPN’s The Pat McAfee Show that Matthew Stafford secretly told him he would return for an 18th NFL season before announcing it during his MVP speech at NFL Honors.
